brand.title: ESourceAIG (Production)
brand.subtitle: Knowledge Check — ESource White-Label Sales Course

questions.question: Which firm is the best fit for the white-label tool?
choices: A bookkeeping or small CPA firm with about 5 to 100 monthly clients that wants its own brand on client work
A firm that needs live bank feeds and built-in payroll
A firm that needs a client login portal and a mobile app
Any business that does its own books once a year
questions.feedback_incorrect: Review slide 2 for the best fit and who isn't a fit yet.

questions.question: A prospect asks how ESource compares with the software they use now. What do you say?
choices: Name the other product and list where it falls short
Quote the other product's price to show ours is lower
"I can only speak to ESource Bookkeeper," then show ESource with sample data
Promise they'll save time and money
questions.feedback_correct: Correct. Speak only about ESource, and show it with sample data.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Don't name, compare or criticize other products, and make no promises. Review slide 11.

questions.question: Which words should you never use about ESource with a prospect?
choices: Sample data and walkthrough
Proven, guaranteed, in minutes, or claims about savings
Per active client book
Ask our team
questions.feedback_correct: Right. No promises and no superiority claims.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Review slide 11: no savings, proven, in minutes or guaranteed claims.

questions.question: What is the monthly price for a firm with 10 active client books?
questions.feedback_correct: Correct. Each rate applies only to the books in its band.
questions.feedback_incorrect: The first book is $20 and books 2-10 are $17 each. Review slide 9.

questions.question: Which page do you use to give a prospect a price estimate?
choices: The staff-only calculator
The public page "Estimate your ESource price" at app.esourcebookkeeper.com/calculator
A spreadsheet you build yourself
A comparison page
questions.feedback_correct: Right. Use only the public estimate page with prospects.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Use the public estimate page; staff tools are internal and never shared. Review slide 10.

questions.question: A firm asks whether its data is safe. What's the right answer?
choices: "It never leaves your computers."
"We're safer than every other product."
Offer a walkthrough of storage, uploads, backups and AI processing with our team
"It's guaranteed."
questions.feedback_correct: Correct. Don't answer from memory; bring in our team.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Don't make promises about data. Review slides 12 and 14.

questions.question: What should you use in a sales walkthrough?
choices: A real client's bank statements
The demo with sample data
The prospect's own client files
Screenshots of another product
questions.feedback_correct: Right. Use sample data only. A pilot with real records is a separate step.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Never use a real client's statements in a walkthrough. Review slide 6.

questions.question: What pilot do you propose?
choices: A free 90-day pilot with all their clients
A pilot with one representative client book, alongside their current system
A 60-day pilot with guaranteed time savings
No pilot; ask them to switch everything at once
questions.feedback_correct: Correct. One representative client book, and our team sets the terms.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Propose one representative client book, and don't promise a length, price or free period. Review slide 15.

questions.question: A firm says moving clients is too much work. What do you offer?
choices: Promise it takes only minutes
Start with one client book, preview it on Client setup, and review it together
Tell them their current software makes moving hard
Offer to move all their clients for free
questions.feedback_correct: Right. Start with one client book and review it together.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Review slide 13: one client book, preview, undo, and review together.

questions.question: What does the AI on Ask Client do?
choices: Changes the books automatically without review
Suggests categories, drafts client questions and matches answers; a person reviews and accepts
Replaces the bookkeeper
Files the client's tax return
questions.feedback_correct: Correct. Nothing changes until a person accepts.
questions.feedback_incorrect: Review slide 8: AI suggests; a person accepts.
